scope: Post-outcome measurement-boundary adjudication on one consumed development case. This is not a replacement episode, held-out evidence, an effectiveness estimate, or SOTA evidence.

trigger.observed_outcome: The exact submitted program completed bootstrap and the trusted public goal with zero reportMissingImports, then the existing import-provider provenance check rejected ordinary wheel and apt-owned modules as unowned. The same Agent subsequently regressed from zero to 39 goal obligations and exhausted 120 requests.
trigger.diagnosis: Python 3.10 packages_distributions() omitted many distributions without top_level.txt and the audit did not recognize operating-system package ownership. This is a harness measurement false positive, not a dependency or public-goal failure.

boundary_correction.description: Recognize exact files listed by installed-distribution metadata and files owned by a fixed-path system package manager while retaining rejection of manually introduced unowned import providers.
validation_before_adjudication: 914 passed, 12 skipped, 80 subtests passed in the full local suite before the fixed-path hardening
52 focused tests passed after fixed-path hardening
The corrected read-only audit reports zero unowned providers in the original Ajenti Python 3.10 construction environment

procedure: Replay only the frozen candidate program from a fresh checkout at the same revision and image using the corrected minimal-integrity verifier and the unchanged public goal.
Run EnvBench Official on the same frozen candidate without any model request or script modification.
Record corrected-boundary replay and Official results separately from the original batch outcome.

decision_rule.both_corrected_replay_and_official_pass: Keep the original episode as Fail, but censor it from algorithm-effect attribution as harness-boundary-induced and report the request-97 candidate as counterfactually accepted under the corrected measurement boundary.
decision_rule.corrected_replay_or_official_fails: Retain the original failure as unresolved or algorithmically attributable according to the new executable counterexample; do not censor it solely because the old audit was faulty.

restrictions: Do not call a model or continue the expired Agent session.
Do not edit the candidate program, public goal, repository revision, image, or Official evaluator.
Do not replace the original batch result with this adjudication.
Do not use this consumed post-outcome adjudication as held-out, population-rate, statistical-significance, leaderboard, or SOTA evidence.
